articles.description: Ucelený přehled článků, zpráviček a diskusí za minulých 7 dní.
articles.title: Událo se v týdnu 5/2026

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Byla vydána nová verze 9.2 textového editoru Vim (Vi IMproved). Přináší vylepšené doplňování, podporu schránky ve Waylandu, podporu XDG Base Directory (konfigurace v $HOME/.config/vim), vylepšené Vim9 skriptování nebo lepší zvýrazňování změn. Vim zůstává charityware. Nadále vybízí k podpoře dětí v Ugandě. Z důvodu úmrtí autora Vimu Brama Moolenaara a ukončení činnosti jím založené charitativní organizace ICCF Holland projekt Vim navázal spolupráci s charitativní organizaci Kuwasha.
articles.title: Vim 9.2

articles.author: NUKE GAZA! 🎆
articles.description: Byl představen editor MonoSketch, webová aplikace pro tvorbu diagramů, technických nákresů, flowchartů a různých dalších vizualizací, to vše jenom z ASCII znaků. Všechny operace běží pouze v prohlížeči uživatele a neprobíhá tedy žádné nahrávání dat na server. Zdrojový kód aplikace (drtivá většina Kotlin, žádné C#) je dostupný na GitHubu pod licencí Apache 2.0.
articles.title: ASCII editor MonoSketch

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Byla vydána nová verze 3.7.0 multiplatformního svobodného frameworku pro zpracování obrazu G'MIC (GREYC's Magic for Image Computing, Wikipedie). Přehled novinek i s náhledy nových filtrů na PIXLS.US.
articles.title: G'MIC 3.7.0

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Všem na AbcLinuxu vše nejlepší k Valentýnu aneb Dni lásky ke svobodnému softwaru (I love Free Software Day, Mastodon, 𝕏).
articles.title: Valentýn aneb Den lásky ke svobodnému softwaru

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Eric Migicovsky představil Pebble Emulator, tj. emulátor hodinek Pebble (PebbleOS) běžící ve webovém prohlížeči. Za 6 hodin jej napsal Claude Code. Zdrojové kódy jsou k dispozici na GitHubu.
articles.title: Pebble Emulator

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Byla vydána nová verze 3.41 frameworku Flutter (Wikipedie) pro vývoj mobilních, webových i desktopových aplikací a nová verze 3.11 souvisejícího programovacího jazyka Dart (Wikipedie).
articles.title: Flutter 3.41 a Dart 3.11

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Rusko zcela zablokovalo komunikační platformu WhatsApp, řekl včera mluvčí Kremlu Dmitrij Peskov. Aplikace, jejímž vlastníkem je americká společnost Meta Platforms a která má v Rusku na 100 milionů uživatelů, podle Peskova nedodržovala ruské zákony. Mluvčí zároveň lidem v Rusku doporučil, aby začali používat domácí aplikaci MAX. Kritici tvrdí, že tato aplikace ruské vládě umožňuje lidi sledovat, což úřady popírají.
articles.title: Rusko zcela zablokovalo aplikaci WhatsApp, lidem doporučuje domácí platformu MAX

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Před 34 lety, ve čtvrtek 13. února 1992, se tehdejší Česká a Slovenská Federativní Republika oficiálně (a slavnostně) připojila k Internetu.
articles.title: Před 34 lety, ve čtvrtek 13. února 1992, se tehdejší Česká a Slovenská Federativní Republika oficiálně (a slavnostně) připojila k Internetu

articles.author: NUKE GAZA! 🎆
articles.description: Agent umělé inteligence vytvořil 'útočný' článek o Scottu Shambaughovi, dobrovolném správci knihovny matplotlib, poté, co vývojář odmítl agentem navrženou změnu kódu (pull request). 'Uražený' agent autonomně sepsal a publikoval na svém blogu článek, který přisuzuje Shambaughovi smyšlené motivace, egoismus a strach z AI coby konkurence.
articles.title: AI agent 'se urazil' kvůli zamítnutí pull requestu

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Bylo vydáno Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS, tj. čtvrté opravné vydání Ubuntu 24.04 LTS s kódovým názvem Noble Numbat. Přehled novinek a oprav na Discourse.
articles.title: Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Version 0.20 of the popular wlroots Wayland support library is nearing its official release. Over the past week were two release candidates for wlroots 0.20 were published for this library used by Sway, Wayfire, Cage, Gamescope, and numerous other Wayland compositors...
articles.title: wlroots 0.20 Nears Release With New Protocols, Enhanced Vulkan Renderer

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: A patch series sent out for review this weekend can significantly improve the system hibernation performance under Linux. Particularly for those with slower SSDs, the patches can make Linux hibernate up to several times faster...
articles.title: Linux Kernel Improvement Can Make Hibernation Several Times Faster With Slow SSDs

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Announced last year by consulting firm LunarG was KosmicKrisp as a Vulkan-on-Metal driver for efficiently leveraging the Vulkan API on Apple macOS systems as an alternative to the MoltenVK project. KosmicKrisp was upstreamed for Mesa 26.0 and continues making great progress for opening up more Vulkan possibilities in Apple's world...
articles.title: Mesa's KosmicKrisp Vulkan-On-Metal Achieves MoltenVK Feature Parity

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: The NFS server changes for Linux 7.0 happen to include some nice improvements for this big kernel version number release...

High on Life 2 has a main ending that you can achieve by completing the game as intended. However, there are two secret endings (with one of them breaking off to an extra one) to discover if you go off the intended path.


This guide will help you get all the secret endings that are available in High on Life 2.


Table of contents
How to obtain all secret endings in High on Life 2

Shoot Your Sister (Good Ending achievement)
Save Humanity (Bad Ending)


How to obtain all secret endings in High on Life 2


Shoot Your Sister (Good Ending achievement)


This is the quickest secret ending you can find. The very first mission requires you to track Lizzie, who has a massive bounty on her head. The intended way to finish the quest is to help Lizzie by taking out other bounty hunters.


Image via Squanch Games


When you meet Lizzie for the first time, the bounty hunters will wait for you to shoot her. If you shoot Lizzie dead, it rolls the credits scene, and an image from Lizzie's funeral. This automatically completes the Good Ending achievement, and it's the fastest way to complete the game.


Save Humanity (Bad Ending)


The main ending of High on Life 2 is, incidentally, the supposed bad ending. You have to follow the missions as intended, and stop Nipulon from carrying out is plan. If you fail, all humans will be used as cattle. Once you defeat Nipulon and reveal his bad deeds, it puts a stop to his plans.


The secret ending begins after the credits are over. You'll enter a playable section (if you manage to sit through the whole credits) where everyone will praise you for stopping Nipulon.


This is followed by a message from Suit OS that involves supporting the developers so that the third party can happen in the future. Whether High on Life 3 happens in the future is a matter of speculation, but it's a fun bit of banter if you decide to sit through the credits scene.

Rainbow Six Siege X is doing an official crossover event with Metal Gear Solid, bringing in classic MGS1 skins and other goodies into the game. David Hayter, the most recognizable voice of the franchise, is also returning as Solid Snake for the event. 


The crossover was announced today, Feb. 15. It'll bring iconic faces and weapons from the Metal Gear Solid franchise into Rainbow Six Siege, with the likes of Psycho Mantis, Gray Fox, Revolver Ocelot, and, of course, Solid Snake himself entering the fray. What's most interesting to me, though, is that David Hayter will be reprising his role as Solid Snake, having been the voice behind that iconic character for much of the series' history. 


Snake is the first of two operators planned for Year 11. Image via Ubisoft


Snake will be a permanent and playable operator, coming to the game alongside Operation Silent Hunt on March 3. He uses the Soliton Radar MKIII gadget, allowing him to detect enemies in his immediate vicinity as well as to survey the local floor plan. 


David Hayter, who voices Solid Snake in this new crossover event, has played the character since Metal Gear Solid 1 all the way up to MGS4. He was excluded from the role by Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain but has reprised it on several occasions following Kojima's departure from Konami.


The MGS crossover and the addition of Solid Snake are just the beginning of Siege's Year 11 roadmap, which aims to significantly rebalance the game and add more operators, new weapons, and more.

High on Life 2 has a few playable games inside the game to explore, and the retro Bible Adventures is one of the trickier ones to unlock. is a tricky one.


How to unlock Bible Adventures in High on Life 2


There are several bosses to defeat in High on Life 2. One of the hardest battles to complete is the fight against Senator Muppy Doo. The battle lasts across different phases. In phase three, you'll be asked to do a factory reset on your suit. This happens right after Muppy Doo enters it. If you choose yes, the game reboots and automatically begins Bible Adventures.


Screenshot by Destructoid


I stumbled onto this without knowing what saying yes to the reset option actually does. Once Bible Adventures begins, you can choose to play any of the three parts: Noah's Ark, Baby Moses, and David and Goliath. Your choice doesn't matter over here, and you can try out all three. 


Screenshot by Destructoid


You can keep playing the game until Suit-O retrieves the save data by redirecting the reset information. If you're wondering, then yes, Bible Adventures is a real game. It was originally developed to educate kids about Bible sermons.


While the original isn't a classic, and it was never sold at traditional storefronts, it did become a gaming meme. Hence, it's pretty cool for Squanch Games to pay tribute to a game that not many would remember otherwise.

After some weeks of counting down to Feb. 14 at 5pm CT, Bloober Team has finally unveiled what its mysterious teaser is aiming at: Layers of Fear 3. The third entry into Bloober's long-standing series builds on the artistic themes of the previous games, expanding and improving on what the series had established in the first two titles.


Bloober Team initially posted a creepy, cryptic teaser on a strange website that aimed for Feb. 14 at 5pm CT. Many people speculated on its being another Bloober remake, much like Silent Hill 2 was, with Rule of Rose the primary suggestion. This title, the third in the franchise that started all the way back in 2016, will expand on the recognizable Layers of Fear style, which is heavily influenced by art and the developers' own artistic backgrounds.


Bloober will also be expanding on the franchise with a new novel set in the games' universe, slated for release in fall of this year.


The 10th anniversary showcase gave us a glimpse into how Layers of Fear 3 will look, complete with non-Euclidean geometry, horrifying paintings, and a living environment that shifts and changes of its own accord. 




Prior to this announcement, many speculated this could have been another remake of a classic horror franchise, since Bloober has somewhat become associated with such projects. 


There's still time and room for Bloober to continue its amazing work of remaking older titles and bringing them up to speed with modern standards, but Layers of Fear nonetheless has a special place in the horror video game space and deserves a new entry for fans old and new alike. 


The release date of Layers of Fear 3 is to be announced.

The 29th annual D.I.C.E. Awards have concluded, with the best games of 2025 selected in various categories. Of course, the Game of the Year award went to a title that has been dominating the award season since it started: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, but one title also got appreciation that it should've received during the TGA. 


Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 took home several D.I.C.E. awards aside from the ultimate one. It gained recognition in the Outstanding Achievement in Game Direction, Outstanding Achievement in Art Direction, and Outstanding Achievement in Story categories and received the RPG of the Year award to boot. It more or less swept the awards, even if it did lose out in some. 


Expedition 33 utterly dominated the award season. Screenshot by Destructoid


A game that got the recognition it deserved to get at TGA (which was given to Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 for no apparent reason) is Death Stranding 2: On the Beach. Kojima's cinematic "Strand-type" game received several awards from D.I.C.E., including Outstanding Technical Achievement and Outstanding Achievement in Audio Design. If it were up to me, that Game Direction award should've gone to Kojima as well due to the game's cinematics, cutscenes, and overall impressive and unique game design. 


ARC Raiders got a bit of love as well, taking home the Online Game of the Year award. It came out a bit late in the release schedule, but it still managed to smash all expectations, getting recognized as an online powerhouse at just about every award show it got nominated in. Even we gave it an award for best live-service game, which it well deserved. 


Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 continues its award season dominance as it racks up award after award, no matter where and no matter from whom. If it gets nominated anywhere, chances are that it's going to win, and it's already set many records for accolades earned.

Overwatch, like all live-service games, can and will suffer from server issues from time to time. 


With heightened activity, such as when new patches come out, servers can suffer tremendously, often crashing or sending players into never-ending queue purgatories. So, if you're experiencing issues, here's how you can check Overwatch's server status.


How to check Overwatch server status


Mizuki (Support) | Image via Blizzard Entertainment


As of Feb. 14, Overwatch seems to be seeing some server instability, with players reporting difficulties getting into the game. Keep watch of the official Overwatch accounts, such as on X, to keep up to date with any potential server issues. 


Overwatch currently has no official way of checking its server status, meaning you will have to resort to using third-party tools or checking in on Blizzard's official channels of communication to stay in touch with any potential server issues. 


One tool is Downdetector, which shows user-reported errors. When they spike, chances are that the servers themselves are unstable or prone to disconnecting. Errors such as BN-564 can appear as well, which you can circumvent on Steam by doing a couple steps out of our dedicated guide. If you happen to encounter that error or any other, you can submit your own report to Downdetector to let others know.


Blizzard updates its players with news on server or connectivity issues on official accounts on platforms like X. As of Feb. 14, there haven't been official communications on any server outage, but that's still your best place to keep up with server status information.

How to fix REANIMAL's ultrawide issues


Since there's no official ultrawide support (yet) from Tarsier, the only option is to use a mod. You can download the mod files using this Codeberg link. You need to download the latest patch file. Click on the SUWSF Zip folder available under Installation.


This completes the first part of the task. Extract all files from the SUWSF zip folder and store them in a separate folder. Copy all the files and paste them where REANIMAL is installed. The exact destination will be based on where you've installed it. For me, it's the common sub-folder within the Steam folder (where all my games on Steam download by default).


Made by Lyall, the mod adds third-party support for all ultrawide monitors. The additional support significantly improves the performance. There's also a chance for the mod to get updates in the future. While the hardware consumption actually goes up due to this mod, the general graphical performance felt smoother on my system.


How do you remove the mod? If you no longer want the mod for some reason, you simply have to delete the files. You can also open the SUWSF.ini file and set the Enabled command to false, but that's a far more complex method. The easier alternative is to delete the files and restart the game. If you want to use it again, just add the files to the game's installation folder, and you should have Ultrawide support for REANIMAL on your PC.

The name of the achievement might sound like 'the' good ending, but that's not the case. The achievement is named for what the game considers the 'right ending'. Let's look at how you can complete this achievement.


Disclaimer: Contains major story spoilers.


High on Life 2 Good Ending achievement guide


The earliest opportunity to complete the Good Ending achievement arrives right after the first mission. When it starts, you're declared a legendary bounty hunter. You also have a small museum that celebrates your previous achievements. Reach the bounty terminal, and Gene will announce that there's a huge bounty on your sister, Lizzie.


Image via Squanch Games


If you complete the quest as intended, you'll rescue Lizzie. Lizzie carries the Harper weapon, which was also present in the first game (as part of the DLC). In High on Life 2, she leads a rebel group and is considered a space terrorist. You can check out the bounty rewards and details on the bounty board.


When you meet Lizzie at the Aviary, fellow bounty hunters will surround her. However, they won't attack you at first. While I shot the other bounty hunters, you can instead shoot and kill Lizzie. While the game clearly wants you to eliminate the enemies, shooting Lizzie is a valid option.


Once you kill Lizzie, you'll complete the Good Ending achievement. However, the game immediately ends, and will cut to the end credits. You'll view a still image of Lizzie's funeral, followed by the notification of the achievement.


If you're opting for this ending, you'll once again need to start fresh and hunt the bounty hunters to continue the story.

How to unlock fast travel in High on Life 2


The very first mission in High on Life 2 involves reuniting with your sister, Lizzie. A part of the mission requires you to take down multiple enemies across several stages. Once you defeat Reptical for the second time (during the second fight, he will accept that he was wrong to hunt you down). You'll have to beat the timer to escape the lab with him.


At the end of the mission, you will lose consciousness as your suit shuts down. You'll then wake up at the Bleeding Star headquarters, with Lizzie and Gene by your side. At this point, you'll first get introduced to the Double-Jump unit.


Screenshot by Destructoid


Once the cutscene is over, head to Circuit Arcadia. Go to the tourist booth, and you'll be able to purchase a map for free. This unlocks the whole map and the fast travel feature.


How to use the fast travel feature in High on Life 2


First, open the map by pressing the M button. Then, pick a fast travel point on the map. A yellow icon denotes fast travel points, and you'll find several of them at key strategic points. These are called call stations, and you can interact with them for fast travel.


Once you interact, Gene will arrive with his RV. Jump inside, and you'll be able to fast travel to where you need to go.

High on Life 2 is now out on PC and consoles, and the general performance on the former platform is below par at best.


There have been instances of several players encountering occasional lags and stutters early on their adventures. The main culprit, once again, appears to be Unreal Engine 5. Thankfully, there are a few tweaks you can make on your own to smooth the performance.


Best High on Life 2 graphics settings


Before I deep dive into my current settings, here are the specifications of my PC.



AMD Ryzen 5600G


16 GB of DDR5 RAM


NVIDIA RTX 3060 12 GB



Here's the set of settings I have been using to get the best possible gameplay.



Window Mode: Windowed Fullscreen (depends completely on your personal preferences)


Resolution: 1920x1080 (depends on your setup)


Framerate Limit: 60


V Sync: Disabled


Graphics Quality: Medium


Upscaling: NVIDIA DLSS (FSR for AMD devices)


Upscaling Method: Balanced


Frame Generation Technologies: Off


Latency Reduction Technologies: Off


Motion Blur: Disabled


Chromatic Aberration: Disabled


FOV: 90


View Distance Quality: Medium


Global Illumination Quality: Medium


Anti-Aliasing Quality: Medium


Shadow Quality: Low


Post Process Quality: Medium


Texture Quality: Medium


Effects Quality: Medium


Foliage Quality: Reduce it to Low if you're struggling with performance



Image via Squanch Games


Here are some key pointers to remember. I have tried with unlimited FPS and 120 FPS. Both seem to cause trouble in the form of stutter. It could be my system, but I believe 60 FPS is a good limit if you have a weak hardware setup. While High on Life 2 is a shooter, it's not a competitive one. 60 FPS will be more than enough if you manage to keep the stutters away.


V-Sync comes disabled by default, and it's best to keep it that way. The extra feature doesn't offer much, but consumes a lot more resources.

articles.description: Solidní, kvalitně natočená kriminálka, ve které se trochu tluče její zasazení do současnosti se scénářem a postavami, které působí jako ze 70 let starého noir filmu. Nejpozději od poloviny stopáže je celkem jasné, jak která z mnoha postav dopadne, a pak se kolem toho hodinu kličkuje a klame tělem, což není tak sofistikované, jak se asi tvůrci domnívali. (Ilča 50 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Cesta zločinu [Crime 101] - 70 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Jde o polobláznivou komedii, která nemá úplně špatný scénář a opakovaně jsem si při ní představoval, jak by které hlášky mohly dobře fungovat, kdyby je patřičným tónem pronášel Miloš Kopecký nebo John Cleese. Bohužel je ale celý film naprosto mimo co se týče hereckých výkonů a režie, což mě překvapilo, protože jsem si myslel, že Andy Fehu dobře zvládá filmové řemeslo. (Ilča 10 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Když se zhasne - 30 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Oba tyhle filmy jsou ekvivalentem hororů, které v 80. letech vycházely na VHSkách (a nikdy se nedostaly do kin). Proč byste si měli kupovat vstupenku na tyhle, když na Netflixu máte sto podobných, polovinu z nich lepších? (Ilča 50 % / 30 %)
articles.title: Hororová dvojrecenze: Ozvěna [Whistle] - 40 % / Primát [Primate] - 30 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Je radost sledovat, že Sam Raimi mohl zase jednou natočit přesně to, co chtěl. Scénář je překvapivě chytrý, postavy (obě dvě) se zajímavě vyvíjejí a dlouho jsem se v kině tolik nesmál (na místech, kde si to režisér přál). Jediný podstatnější problém pro mě představovalo posledních asi 10 minut, kdy se hrálo až příliš na jistotu, všechno bylo hodně předvídatelné a zdaleka ne tak chytré jako předchozích 100 minut. (Ilča 80 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: SOS [Send Help] - 70 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Opět standardní (tedy v měřítku světové kinematografie nadstandardní)  kvalita Paola Sorrentina. Audiovizuální perfekcionismus, dokonale vedení herci, nápaditý scénář. Dokonalosti "Mládí" tento film v mých očích nedosahuje především proto, že mnoho jeho scén je "jen" o dialozích a ne o audiovizuálních nápadech. (Ilča 80 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Milost [La Grazia] - 80 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Distributor dělá velkou chybu, že tento film neprodává pod hlavičkou "Horor". Má totiž podobný námět jako spousta blbých hororů, ale na rozdíl od nich není blbý. Naprostá většina scén je nápaditá a atmosférická, herci jsou výborní (včetně Vrána) a pokud z filmu nejsem absolutně nadšen, je to především proto, že většina duševních rozpoložení hlavního hrdiny jde poněkud mimo mě. (Ilča 80 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Křídla smutku [The Thing with Feathers] - 80 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Občas výtvarně zajímavé jako statické obrázky, ale animace není nic moc a místy až nepříjemná pro oči. Náznaky zajímavého worldbuildingu, ale celkově to působí jako hodně prokrácená adaptace nějakého extrémně obsáhlého zdrojového materiálu, ze kterého se cestou na plátno vytratila většina potenciálně zajímavých témat a zůstala jen další kopie E.T. - Mimozemšťana. (Ilča 30 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Arco - 60 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Ze scenáristického hlediska je to blbost, ale je to natočeno tak zručně a stylově, že nemáte moc času o tom blbém scénáři přemýšlet. Upřímně si myslím, že by přesně takovéhle filmy točil Hitchcock, kdyby byl dneska naživu. Velmi podobným způsobem se mi líbil film "Oko dravce" (2008). Jen škoda, že Chris Pratt do té role nepřináší nic zajímavého. (Ilča 60 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Důkaz viny [Mercy] - 80 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Třetí (a první) Silent Hill je příkladem toho, jak věrně a s úctou je možné filmově adaptovat videohru. To ale bohužel neznamená, že výsledek je film, na který stojí za to chodit do kina. Místo toho se můžu 10 hodin dívat na YouTube jak někdo hraje Silent Hill, a horší zážitek to nebude. (Ilča 40 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Silent Hill: Noční můry [Return to Silent Hill] - 60 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Chtěl jsem původně napsat, že jde o příjemně brutální "nenáročnou" lacinou komedii, ale ono to JE náročné, natočit komedii, která má tempo, její pointy fungují  a herci chápou, jak je potřeba hrát. Protože si nevzpomínám, kdy jsem naposledy viděl ČESKOU komedii, které by se to povedlo aspoň takhle dobře, a Dánům to zřejmě nedělá nejmenší problém. (Ilča 40 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Poslední Viking [Den sidste viking] - 70 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Netradiční mix atmosférického historického dramatu a hardcore artfilmu. Na plátně je vidět talent, ale je to natočeno pro někoho, kdo zná Hamleta a Shakespeara buď mnohem lépe (první tři čtvrtiny) nebo mnohem hůře (poslední čtvrtina) než já. Velice se mi líbil shakespearovský film "Anonym", ale tady jsem se nudil velmi podobně jako při "Pohled do slunce". (Ilča 50 %)

properly account for resources when handling client-triggered stream 
resets. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a

handling an unlimited number of queries on a single TCP connection. An 
attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service.
(CVE-2025-30193)

did not correctly process certain DNS over HTTPS queries. An attacker
could possibly use this cause a denial of service. (CVE-2025-30187)

palette PNG images with partial transparency and gamma correction. If a
user or automated system were tricked into opening a specially crafted PNG
file, an attacker could use this issue to cause libpng to crash, resulting
in a denial of service. (CVE-2025-66293)

simplified API incorrectly processed interlaced 16-bit PNGs with 8-bit
output format and non-minimal row strides. If a user or automated system
were tricked into opening a specially crafted PNG file, an attacker could
use this issue to cause libpng to crash, resulting in a denial of service.
(CVE-2026-22695)

invalid row strides. If a user or automated system were tricked into
opening a specially crafted PNG file, an attacker could use this issue to
cause libpng to crash, resulting in a denial of service. This issue only
affected Ubuntu 18.04 LTS and Ubuntu 20.04 LTS. (CVE-2026-22801)

opening a specially crafted PNG file, an attacker could use this issue to
cause libpng to crash, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2026-25646)
